findings.title: Scoring instructions and validation disagreed
findings.cause: The prompt required reasons only for intermediate scores and used an ambiguous rubricReasons placeholder; the validator required nonempty explanations for every dimension, including zero and anchor scores.
findings.fix: List all eight explanation keys explicitly and require 1-600 characters for every dimension. Keep the existing numeric rubric values and 60/40 scoring policy.

findings.title: One missing scoring explanation discarded the entire reply
findings.cause: RESEARCH_RUBRIC_REASON threw from inside the per-source loop, losing the conversation and otherwise valid peers after a successful provider response.
findings.fix: After mandatory source and numeric validation, quarantine only assessments with unexplained positive scores into an unscored list. Preserve source links, verified quotes, dialogue and valid peer scores. Zero-point missing reasons receive an administrative note without changing a number or inventing a scientific rationale.

findings.title: Partial scoring needs honest state and durable diagnostic boundaries
findings.cause: The previous pipeline exposed only all-passed or all-rejected and logged the collection field, without the affected source or dimension. Revalidating sanitized partial responses from cache could lose the scoring warning.
findings.fix: Return partial validation receipts and per-source/per-dimension bounded diagnostics. Display the scoring limitation in chat and source cards. Preserve stale recommendation state during partial reviews. Do not cache recovered assessments; normal complete replies keep caching. Persist partial responses in chat history.

limitations: The original rejected raw answer was not retained. The precise missing/empty/invalid/overlong dimension cannot be reconstructed; code inspection proves the prompt/validator mismatch and whole-response failure behavior.
No live provider call is authorized for this patch yet. The previous 0.3.2 live test covered only a language request; it is not evidence for this scientific scenario.
A valid quote and explanation establish traceability, not scientific correctness. Unscored sources receive no numerical total and are not inserted into the sorted scored list.

Partial scoring keeps previous recommendations unchanged/stale pending a complete review. Other invalid source references, quotes, rubric values, duplicate sources or envelope fields still reject the response; this is a bounded correction, not universal recovery.
No dataset, formula, weights, private API key or private transcript was changed. Node SEA remains the runtime; NPR 7150.2D Class C remains an incomplete engineering target, not certification.
